summary_en: Update on cost-of-capital and stock-price-conscious management framework. Prior disclosure issued June 26, 2025. Detailed targets and metrics to be found in attached material.
title_en: Disclosure Regarding Measures to Realize Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: Nippon Care Supply issued an update on June 26, 2026 to its cost-of-capital and stock-price-conscious management framework, first disclosed on June 26, 2025. The filing announces a review of current performance against stated objectives and articulation of future implementation measures. The company directs readers to attached supporting materials for specific targets, metrics, and operational details. No numeric capital-allocation parameters are provided in the cover sheet.
